Spread across a sprawling 6.42 acres, the project features 6 or 7 majestic high-rise towers soaring G+25 floors. Constructed using advanced Mivan/Korean aluminum shuttering technology, the development is engineered for extreme structural durability, clean alignment, and earthquake resistance. Each tower is designed with strict low-density specifications, offering only two premium corner apartments per floor, ensuring 270-degree panoramic green views, maximum daylight optimization, and seamless ventilation.
